name: Legacy Monolithic Order Desk Baseline
description: Captures the initial TraderX equities desk where traderx-web posts orders over plain HTTP directly into monolith-order-svc backed by oracle-trades-db without gateway isolation or transport encryption.

name: Zero-Trust API Gateway & OIDC Enforcement
description: Introduces edge-api-gateway and ping-oidc-idp per ADR-001, severing direct browser-to-monolith access, enforcing PKCE token introspection, and mandating the mtls-everywhere control on internal hops.

name: Order Router Extraction & Kafka Backbone
description: Extracts stateless order-router-svc ahead of kafka-event-bus per ADR-002 and defines order-submission-flow so ingress order capture decouples cleanly from downstream trade booking.

name: Pre-Trade Risk Circuit Breaker & Cache
description: Deploys pretrade-risk-svc backed by redis-position-cache per ADR-003, gating order-router-svc over synchronous gRPC/mTLS credit and fat-finger checks before orders reach kafka-event-bus.

name: FIX Venue Execution & Live Market Data
description: Adds fix-execution-gateway connected to external-liquidity-venue over FIX-4.4/TLS alongside market-data-feed and execution-fill-flow for real-time mark-to-market exposure and drop-copy fills.

name: Legacy Monolith Retirement & Clearing Split
description: Migrates trade persistence and clearing to trade-ledger-svc, settlement-clearing-svc, and postgres-trades-db over TLS, permanently decommissioning monolith-order-svc and oracle-trades-db.

name: SEC 17a-4 Immutable WORM Audit Archive
description: Streams Kafka execution events through worm-audit-archiver into s3-object-lock-vault per ADR-004, binding the sec-17a4-worm retention control and exposing audit verification to compliance-officer.

name: DORA Multi-Region Failover & Telemetry
description: Adds dr-standby-cluster replication and otel-observability-hub distributed tracing per ADR-005, codifying operational failover readiness under the dora-ict-resilience control.

name: FINRA CAT T+1 Regulatory Reporting Pipeline
description: Launches cat-regulatory-reporter reconciled against s3-object-lock-vault and trade-ledger-svc to transmit SFTP/mTLS reports to finra-cat-portal under regulatory-cat-submission-flow and finra-cat-sla.
